title: Object Model Gauntlet
prompt: Implement the three functions so every check passes: a by-value factory, a reference-returning accessor with persistent storage, and a destruction-order reporter.

tests.name: factory is prvalue
tests.hint: Return a std::string by value containing "tag".

tests.name: registry is lvalue with persistence
tests.hint: Back it with a function-local static std::string and return std::string&.

tests.name: pops reports reverse destruction
tests.hint: Destruction is reverse construction order; join with commas, no spaces.
